claims.claim_text: Xometry's distinctive brand name should appear in US-listed-filer disclosures (counterparties, suppliers, customers, competitors). Xometry has been NASDAQ-listed (XMTR) since June 30, 2021 and serves industries including Aerospace, Healthcare, Defense, and Automotive across Fortune 100 companies.
claims.subject: Xometry
claims.object_value: Xometry brand mentioned in US-listed-filer 10-K/10-Q/8-K disclosures
claims.source_quote: Our buyers include engineers, product designers, procurement and supply chain personnel, inventors, entrepreneurs and business owners from businesses of a variety of sizes, ranging from self-funded start-ups to Fortune 100 companies.

queries.rationale: Xometry is a distinctive single-word brand; as NASDAQ-listed marketplace touching Fortune 100 buyers and ~3,400 active suppliers, should have substantial filing footprint (own filings + supplier/competitor mentions).

claims.claim_text: Xometry acquired Thomas Publishing Company (Thomasnet platform) in December 2021; Thomasnet is described as 'a leading industrial sourcing platform in North America' with data covering 70,000+ industrial processes.
claims.subject: Thomasnet (Xometry subsidiary)
claims.object_value: Thomasnet brand mentioned in US-listed-filer disclosures
claims.source_quote: Subsequently, we acquired Thomas Publishing Company and its subsidiaries (Thomas) which has data and information about suppliers which offer over 70,000 industrial processes... Through Thomasnet, a leading industrial sourcing platform in North America, we offer suppliers an array of digital advertising and marketing services and data solutions on Thomasnet.

queries.rationale: Thomasnet is a long-established (since 1898) industrial directory; if 'leading' platform claim is true, should have nontrivial footprint in industrial-co filings (suppliers using it for marketing) — also pre-dates Xometry acquisition.

claims.claim_text: Xometry has been awarded patents on its proprietary AI/ML quoting and pricing technology (the Xometry Instant Quoting Engine), which underpins the marketplace and constitutes core IP.
claims.subject: Xometry, Inc.
claims.object_value: Patents covering AI/ML pricing, quoting, manufacturability analysis

claims.claim_text: Xometry acquired Tridi Teknoloji A.S. located in Istanbul, Turkey on January 2, 2023, extending European marketplace capabilities and access to the Turkish market.
claims.subject: Tridi Teknoloji A.S. (Xometry subsidiary)
claims.source_quote: On January 2, 2023, the Company acquired Tridi Teknoloji A.S. (Tridi) located in Istanbul, T rkiye pursuant to a Share Purchase Agreement. The acquisition of Tridi extends our marketplace capabilities in Europe and provides us access to the Turkish market.

queries.rationale: Tridi acquisition disclosure check; 'Tridi' is a single distinctive word, expect Xometry's own filings to mention; minimal external footprint (private Turkish startup) is normal.

claims.claim_text: Xometry integrated the Gravity Climate API into its marketplace in 2022 to calculate carbon emissions estimates for orders, enabling buyers to optionally purchase carbon credits.
claims.subject: Xometry partnership with Gravity Climate
claims.object_value: Gravity Climate API integrated into Xometry marketplace (2022)
claims.source_quote: In 2022, we integrated the Gravity Climate API into our marketplace. The Gravity Climate API calculates carbon emissions estimates for Xome[try]... we offer buyers the ability to purchase carbon credits to offset the carbon used to make and ship their parts.

queries.rationale: Gravity Climate is a private VC-backed startup; minimal external SEC disclosure expected (per heuristic 4: investment partners often don't disclose). Check Xometry's own filings reference, treat 0 as PASS-by-default.
